scope: Aggregate native Player::LoadFromDB after spirit healer transfer refusal or interrupted far transfer; saved health, native inventory and offline sickness
finding: Production defect reproduced and fixed: LoadFromDB clamps saved health against the temporary1HP maximum before the queued stamina update has calculated the item/aura-adjusted maximum. Selected-field reload components in prior audits did not execute this aggregate ordering.

implementation: After UpdateAllStats schedules the pending stats, LoadFromDB calls native UpdateStats(STAT_STAMINA) and consumes only USM_STAMINA before the existing saved-health maximum clamp. Other stats and delayed operations keep their normal lifecycle. This avoids processing unrelated delayed pet/item operations early and prevents a repeated stale stamina percentage update on the first tick.
checks: Each full login constructs native LoginQueryHolder(account0,guid), calls Initialize and executes its entire query set through CharacterDatabase.DelayQueryHolder on the scratch character schema. A fresh ordinary Player(session) calls the actual linked Player::LoadFromDB; the fixture does not manually assign loaded health, flags, inventory, auras or map position.

The existing failure fixture now supplies valid letter-only names and Warrior specialization71 before the initial save. Native ObjectMgr::LoadPlayerInfo supplies race/class/stats/defaults with MaxPlayerLevel110. Custom starting quests are empty in the live world data; an admission check requires any future rows to belong to the loaded fixture quest catalog. No world temporary table or live world write is used in the final fixture.

All56 prior refusal/TCP-loss/idle-timeout paths now perform three sequential aggregate logins after their selected-field component control. Setting only each fixture row logout_time to native GameTime minus0/20/700 seconds exercises real LoadFromDB time_diff handling. Health remains321 and the original item GUID/entry25/durability27 reloads through actual inventory loading.

Sickness15007 reloads at598000ms, then578000ms after20 seconds offline, then is absent after700 additional seconds offline. The native maximum is calculated from actual race/class/item/aura state; saved health321 survives both active sickness and its expiry. An explicit native UpdateStatsByMask after each aggregate load proves the first deferred stat flush preserves that health and alive state.

Each aggregate load uses the selected native map, actual AddPlayerToMap and CheckInstanceLoginValid, then the same native LoadCorpse and UpdateZone components used to complete login. It reaches the expected map0/1/1220 position/orientation and native destination worker, alive/in-world, with no corpse or pending teleport.

Stale old-session ACK/resurrection and a repeated new-session resurrection cannot change health/durability or create a corpse. Native LogoutPlayer(true) then deletes the Player and persists the exact admitted map/XYZ/orientation/zone, health321, non-ghost flags and offline state. The next age reads that new native save and inventory again.
